### last time {.smaller}

*  ready-to-send/clear-to-send
   *  "solves" hidden node (and makes exposed node worse)
   *  extra overhead to get permission to send messages
*  multipath interference, multiple spatial streams
*  infrastructure mode
   *  going through current access point
   *  access points tracking where every node is
*  mesh networks --- routing over wireless
*  cellular networks
   *  base stations planning everyone's transmissions
   *  "tunnels" to more central locations
*  packet filters
